paper.title: PhysDreamer
paper.data: static 3D objects, video-diffusion dynamics priors, material-field estimates, and interaction examples for elastic objects
paper.method: distills video generation priors into a physical material field and uses physics simulation to synthesize action-conditioned object dynamics
paper.task: make static 3D objects respond to external forces or manipulation in physically plausible ways
paper.novelty: uses video-generation dynamics priors to estimate material behavior for interactive 3D object simulation
paper.project_relevance: Provides concrete fields for MaterialField, ExternalForce, DynamicResponse, and DeformableState validators.

paper.title: Feature Splatting
paper.data: 3D Gaussian scenes with distilled foundation-model features, text-grounded decomposition, material queries, and physics-simulation examples
paper.method: feature-bearing 3D Gaussians plus text-query segmentation and particle-based physics simulation with automatically assigned material properties
paper.task: language-driven physics-based scene synthesis, editing, and material-aware simulation
paper.novelty: turns 3DGS from a visual representation into a semantic/material/physics-aware editing and simulation substrate
paper.project_relevance: Useful for SceneRepresentation, MaterialProperty, SegmentByText, PhysicsEdit, and simulator-backed validation.

paper.title: Holodeck
paper.data: language prompts, Objaverse assets, AI2-THOR environments, human evaluations, and NoveltyTHOR navigation benchmark
paper.method: LLM-driven environment generation with spatial relational constraints, asset retrieval, layout optimization, and AI2-THOR integration
paper.task: generate customized 3D embodied AI environments from natural language
paper.novelty: uses LLM commonsense plus constraint optimization to generate diverse interactive AI2-THOR environments from open-ended prompts
paper.project_relevance: Important baseline for Prompt, SceneSpec, SpatialConstraint, AssetRetrieval, LayoutOptimization, and downstream embodied evaluation.

paper.title: Infinigen Indoors
paper.data: fully procedural indoor scenes, furniture, architecture elements, appliances, and dense synthetic labels from Blender
paper.method: procedural indoor asset and layout generation with a constraint DSL and solver for scene composition
paper.task: generate photorealistic indoor scenes and annotations for vision/embodied research
paper.novelty: extends Infinigen from natural worlds to indoor procedural scenes with real geometry and controllable annotations
paper.project_relevance: Strong generator for Scene, Asset, Annotation, LayoutConstraint, and synthetic data pipelines.
